verdict.rationale: Ironclad is a contract-management SaaS platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack documents a REST API, OAuth, webhooks, and an llms.txt file, but none of it mentions an official MCP server. Those are adjacent developer building blocks and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
